text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED 1718632100 - Canary health deviation detected for rollout v5-snap in EU1. error_rate=8% (baseline 0.3%). Auto-snapback attempted. Paging @oncall-sre.

olivia: Oncall here. Seeing pages, jumping in. What is the customer impact right now?

sam: Errors correlate with increased inference timeouts -> 4% 5xx for hosted API EU. A handful of customers reported failed requests (~1.2% of overall traffic). Auto-rollout tried to revert but looks partial.

maria: Can someone confirm the traffic-split state? `kubectl get trafficsplit v5-snap -o yaml` shows controllers disagreeing.

kevin: I'm seeing the same. One traffic pool still has 20% pinned to v5-snap. Seems like a controller race between rollout-controller and autoscaler.

oncall-bot: Paging @kevin @olivia - primary oncall.

kevin: Taking lead. Applying manual patch to set v5-snap weight=0.

kevin: Running: ```kubectl patch trafficsplit v5-snap -p '{"spec":{"backends":[{"service":"v5-snap","weight":0}]}}'``` Will monitor.

sam: FYI, logs show KV cache warmup failures in v5 during scale-up, causing timeouts. v4 doesn't have that issue.

olivia: Setting priority P1 due to customer-facing 5xxs. @maria can you run smoke tests against v4 and confirm readiness for full traffic?

maria: Running smoke suite now. Quick check: `curl -sS https://eu.api.redwood.test/health` -> 200 on v4. Running sample inference flows.

kevin: Patch applied. TrafficSplit now reports v5 weight=0 for all pools. Confirmed via control plane UI and `kubectl get trafficsplit`.

olivia: Good. Any residual errors at edge or CDN level?

sam: Some 502 spikes from edge caches still visible. I'll trigger a CDN purge in EU1 for affected paths.

sam: Purge issued: `cdnctl purge --region eu1 --paths /v5/*` — started.

maria: Smoke tests passing end-to-end against v4. No 5xxs in the last 2m from test harness.

olivia: Customer impact summary: preliminary - ~3 customers reported intermittent failures, overall ~1.2% of requests affected, mostly EU region. CS notified.

oncall-bot: Handoff: nightshift escalation. @kevin will remain as primary until verification window complete. @olivia escalating notes to eng-sre.

kevin: I'll stay and monitor for 30m. Running e2e checks every 2m and keeping watch on `error_rate`, `latency_p50/p95`.

sam: Root cause (prelim): concurrent controller writes during canary + missing pre-traffic KV warmup in v5 causing timeouts under partial traffic. Auto-snapback tried but due to race some sessions pinned to v5.

olivia: Action items: (1) immediate - manual rollback verified (kevin), purge CDN (sam), notify CS (olivia). (2) follow-up - add pre-traffic warmup for canaries, add a rollout lock between autoscaler and rollout-controller, add additional canary smoke tests. Filing INF-2452 for follow-up.

kevin: Creating hotfix PR to add rollout lock and a small wait/warmup step; will link to INF-2452. ETA for PR: 2h.

maria: I'll add a focused e2e test to the canary pipeline to exercise KV warmup in the pre-traffic phase.

olivia: Plan: keep incident open until 30m steady state with no >0.5% 5xx. If stable, we close and transition to postmortem. Assigning oncall to kevin until 00:30 UTC.

sam: Noting customer reports in incident log. Will coordinate with CS for any follow-ups.

kevin: 10m check: metrics look stable, error_rate back to baseline. No new customer reports in last 8m.

olivia: Excellent. Marking manual rollback complete. Will schedule postmortem and timeline. Thanks all :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident 1718632100 status=acknowledged, state=manual-rollback-complete, owner=kevin, priority=P1. Next update scheduled in 20m for closure verification.
